responsibility: Primary implementation of the `Backend` abstraction that lowers the Go frontend’s internal IR into GCC trees, declarations, and GIMPLE-ready function bodies. This file defines the GCC-backed wrapper classes for types, expressions, statements, functions, blocks, labels, and variables; builds Go types and expressions as GCC trees; records parameters and bodies for functions; defines and looks up builtins; finalizes global declarations through cgraph and `wrapup_global_declarations`; and hands export data emission back to the GCC-side helpers, making it the core code-generation bridge from Go frontend semantics to GCC middle-end IR.
same_name_distinction: Implements the concrete GCC-backed Go backend declared by go-gcc.h: it defines the Gcc_backend class and related wrapper objects, performs the actual lowering to GCC trees/GIMPLE, manages builtins and global finalization, and provides the go_get_backend factory body rather than just its declaration.
